title: portulaca pilosa var. tuberosa
intro: Portulaca pilosa var. tuberosa, commonly known as  Moss Rose or Pusley, is a flowering plant species in the Portulacaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Portulaca pilosa var. tuberosa include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
